summary: The StudentPRPreferenceHistory module records and displays a history of student PR (Placement Request) preference actions for a given student and timetable. It retrieves detailed records of actions performed, including who performed them, when, and what fields were affected.
purpose: To track, display, and provide business context for individual student PR placement preference actions over time for audit and review purposes.

workflows.name: Retrieve Student PR Preference History
steps: Instantiate StudentPRPreferenceHistoryList with session, studentID, and timetableID.
Execute DB procedure and read SqlDataReader rows.
For each row, populate StudentPRPreferenceHistory fields.
Select UserAction and Fields based on language preference.
Gather additional fields: Agency, AgencyName, LastName, FirstName, MiddleName, Phone, ByUserID, ByOriginalUserID, ByUserSysAdmin.
Bind Data to gridData in UI.

workflows.name: Display Student PR Preference History
steps: Data is bound to gridData GridView for display in UI.

business_rules: ActionDate is formatted for display (not stored as DateTime).
UserAction and Fields are selected according to language field preference (UseAltLanguageFields).
AgencyUser is calculated: if not SysAdmin and ByUserID differs from ByOriginalUserID, prepend support team info.
AgencyUserDetails shows formatted name and agency, includes phone if present.
validations: UUIDs for document IDs and DB parameters.
Fields are retrieved with proper type casting (string, int, boolean).
calculations: AgencyUser: prepends support team caption for certain conditions, concatenates agency and user initials.
UserInitials: concatenates first, middle, last initial if present.
AgencyUserDetails: formatted name and agency, optionally phone.
conditions: If UseAltLanguageFields is true, use alternate field names.
AgencyUser calculation changes if ByUserSysAdmin is false and ByUserID differs from original.
Phone is included in AgencyUserDetails if not empty.
system_behavior: On DataBind, retrieves history, binds to UI grid.
Auto-generated fields are noted for designer/code-behind separation.
exceptions: If DB reader returns null, no entries are processed.
If fields are missing, user initials or details are incomplete.
content_gaps: No explicit mention of permissions for viewing histories.
No details on error handling when DB connection fails.
No UI specification beyond field bindings and control types.
No detailed description of how alternate language fields are defined.
